## Code agent policy

Pull requests and issues from first-time contributors should not be written by a code agent. If you used one,
read [Contributing with code agents](https://github.com/Andreas-Hum/tinydistill/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#contributing-with-code-agents)
first.

- [ ] (First-time contributors only): I confirm that this PR description and code is not written by an LLM or
  code agent

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change was discussed in an issue first (not needed for documentation or typo fixes)
- [ ] Tests are added or updated
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated if behaviour or options changed
- [ ] Any numbers added to the README or RESULTS come from saved result files, not typed by hand
